description: This Java class manages media playback notifications for a media session, updating and displaying notifications with playback controls, media metadata, and album art in an Android media app.

classes.name: MediaNotificationManager
classes.description: Manages media playback notifications, updating them based on media session state, and handles user interactions via broadcast intents.

methods.name: MediaNotificationManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the notification manager, session token, and intents.

methods.name: startNotification
methods.description: Posts the notification and begins tracking the media session.

methods.name: stopNotification
methods.description: Removes the notification and stops tracking the media session.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles broadcast intents for media control actions.

methods.name: updateSessionToken
methods.description: Updates the media session token and controller.

methods.name: createContentIntent
methods.description: Creates intent to open the media player UI.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Builds and returns the media notification based on current media metadata and playback state.

methods.name: addPlayPauseAction
methods.description: Adds play or pause action button to the notification based on playback state.

methods.name: setNotificationPlaybackState
methods.description: Updates notification's playback position and ongoing status.

methods.name: fetchBitmapFromURLAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches album art from URL and updates notification.
